title: History Export Sentinel
user: People archiving or moving their browser history who need a cross-platform export they can verify is complete before an account or machine changes.
smallest_useful_product: A local CLI that detects installed Chromium/Firefox profiles, copies databases safely, exports normalized JSON/CSV, and reports record/date ranges, locked-profile errors, and hashes.
success_measure: On fixture sets for Firefox and Chromium, the tool either exports expected count/date ranges or emits a non-zero actionable failure; no silent empty export.
constraints: Read copies only, never touch live browser databases; clearly handle profile encryption and OS permissions; history is highly sensitive and must never leave the device.
